description: This file defines a PHP class 'Beta' for calculating beta distribution functions, including distribution, inverse, incomplete beta, and related mathematical computations, with support for array inputs and caching.

classes.name: Beta
classes.description: A class providing methods for beta distribution calculations, including distribution, inverse, and incomplete beta functions, with support for array inputs and caching.

methods.name: distribution
methods.description: Calculates the beta distribution value for given parameters or array of values.

methods.name: inverse
methods.description: Calculates the inverse of the beta distribution for given probability or array of probabilities.

methods.name: calculateInverse
methods.description: Performs binary search to find the inverse beta distribution value.

methods.name: incompleteBeta
methods.description: Computes the incomplete beta function using continued fractions.

methods.name: logBeta
methods.description: Calculates the natural logarithm of the beta function with caching.

methods.name: betaFraction
methods.description: Evaluates the continued fraction part of the incomplete beta function.
